metadata.project-name: AWOS — Learnable OS for Autonomous Work

soul.identity: AWOS is a learnable operating system for autonomous work — not a Cursor competitor. Coding agent is App #1. North star: maximize Quality × Speed ÷ Cost (PEI). GTM: agency-first (~1,000 niche users). See VISION.md and docs/NICHE_GTM.md.

rules.rule: AWOS_CHEAP_ONLY=true and AWOS_PREMIUM_BUDGET=0 during v1 self-validation
Goals must use full paths: scaffold/agent/<file>.py and name the target symbol
Never route to Haiku/Sonnet when cheap-only is active
Measure real API tokens; derive cost from token counts, not flat tier estimates
After each successful run: check APPLIED CHANGE box + git diff
No agency outreach until 10–15 validation runs pass cost + quality criteria

pattern.fix: cheap_planner._normalize_plan_paths(); always include full path in goal

pattern.symptom: Goal asks for # comment above symbol; worker edits inner docstring only
pattern.fix: verifier._check_edit_fidelity() rejects; re-run worker with error context

pattern.symptom: Integration review flags hallucinated import/call-chain issues on truncated diffs
pattern.fix: Filter noise; tune reviewer — known issue as of 2026-06-12

pattern.symptom: Rolling METRICS panel shows high cost from historical premium spans
pattern.fix: Trust awos budget and [OBS] line for new cheap-only runs

decisions.decision: PEI reporting uses real API tokens as primary cost measure (usage_record.py, pei_report.py)
print_visual_diff() in run_diagnostics.py — shown after successful verify in orchestrator
Self-validate on own repo before agency outreach; log in docs/V1_VALIDATION.md
AWOS = learnable OS kernel; coding is App #1; niche agent-making firm GTM

record.note: cheap-only era total via awos budget
